newsitem.title: GERMANY: Altana shares climb on talk of new product.
newsitem.headline: Altana shares climb on talk of new product.

text.p: Shares in pharmaceutical group Altana AG stormed higher on Wednesday buoyed by market talk the group would soon present a new product.
Extending gains amassed in post-bourse trade on Tuesday, shares climbed 7.65 percent in early Frankfurt bourse trade, sending prices to 1,830 marks per share, nominally valued at 50 marks.
Besides talk of the possible new product, there is also some talk that a share price goal of 2,600 marks had been set by a broker. "It is rumours that are driving this move," a dealer said.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
An analyst at Bayerische Vereinsbank said the move was slightly irrational and that there were no real reasons for the jump.
